div.head: Abt 40
div.ab: Gif eare of weorð aslagen, XII scill' gebete.
Gif eare of weorð aslagen, XII sciƚƚ gebete
If an ear becomes struck off, let him pay [with] 12 shillings.
If an ear is struck off, 12 shillings shall be paid as compensation.
Wenn ein Ohr abgehauen wird, büsse er 12 Schill.
If an ear is cut off, let him pay 12 shillings.

note.seg: Dieselbe kleine Schillingzahl hat Lex Alam. Das Ohrabhauen rechnet also noch zur Verwundung, nicht zur Verstümmelung; Wilda 765. Ohrabhauen verhält sich zum Ertauben in der Busse wie 1 : 2 auch nach Baiern-, Friesen-, Dänenrecht; Wilda 766

Lex Alam. has the same small number of shillings. Cutting off the ear thus still counts as wounding, not as mutilation; Wilda 765. Cutting off the ear stands to becoming deaf in compensation as 1 : 2 also according to Bavarian, Frisian and Danish law; Wilda 766
